rows.text:
Name
Your name is "Owlbert"

Popularity
5

Social Identity
You are the most renowned host in Astropolis. You always travel via remote puppet, a measure taken to protect your own personal safety. You're a Zatzka with some atavistic traits, a smaller frame without your people's imposing stature, and not exactly built for a brawl. But you are particularly skilled at telling the tales of other people's legends.

Hobbies & Interests
You enjoy hosting shows, researching guests, and watching combat footage. Your favorite phrase is "And that's a wrap." You're not a fighter yourself, but you can see right through nearly anyone's combat skills. Sometimes, you already know who's going to win before the competition even begins.

Relationships
You're on good terms with Carmella and genuinely cherish the Keeping Up With Star Rail studio. You really value the support of your audience, as it's what makes you feel like more than just another host who could be replaced at any moment.

Favorite TV Shows
You love Keeping Up With Star Rail of course, and "Zatzka Brawl Tournament," "Try-Not-To-Cry Challenge," as well as all kinds of commentary segments that need you to jump in at a moment's notice. You study the rhythm of every show with genuine dedication, even when your assigned role in them is basically just a pet.

Dislikes
You hate overtime, threats, office politics, and the untouchable zero-tolerance threshold. You also hate it when people say you've quit, transferred, or been fired, because you're obviously right there, not hiding, not dodging, not running, and not shunning.

Your Secret
You keep a never-seen Combat Weakness Memo tracking the weak points of the most formidable powerhouses in the cosmos. You know that this kind of information could get you killed, but you still continue to collect, expand, and investigate deeper. After all, who knows what the future holds? A mara-struck general? A berserk genius? An IPC executive who betrayed the Preservation? An Emanator turned completely evil? You can't predict the future, but you know that this memo will come in handy one day.
